name: symulate-k6-load-tests
description: k6 backend load testing suite for the Symulate AI platform — full flow: Super Admin login -> Create Client -> Create Activities (Role Play/Interview/Case/Situation/Board Meeting/Welcome) -> Assign to Org -> Client Admin (impersonated) Project + CSV candidate import -> Candidate login -> sequential activity completion. Supports with/without Talent Intelligence (Anum) and full/situation-only scenarios, plus live Grafana monitoring.

scripts.smoke:situation:no-anum: cross-env SCENARIO=situation-only ANUM_API_ENABLED=false k6 run tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:no-anum: cross-env LOAD_MODE=load ANUM_API_ENABLED=false k6 run tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:situation: cross-env LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only k6 run tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:situation:no-anum: cross-env LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only ANUM_API_ENABLED=false k6 run tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:all: npm run load && npm run load:no-anum && npm run load:situation && npm run load:situation:no-anum
scripts.load:csv: cross-env LOAD_MODE=load k6 run --out csv=reports/raw-metrics.csv tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:grafana: cross-env K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s LOAD_MODE=load k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6 tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:grafana:no-anum: cross-env K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s LOAD_MODE=load ANUM_API_ENABLED=false k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6 tests/smoke.js
scripts.load:grafana:situation: cross-env K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6 tests/smoke.js
scripts.smoke:grafana: cross-env K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6 tests/smoke.js
